title: Hearty Argentinian Chicken Empanadas
description: Earthy and pillowy Argentinian dish featuring chicken breasts, deep-fry-tod, diabetic-friendly, vessel=comal
instructions: Preheat the comal or a large skillet over medium heat.
Season the chicken breasts with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the olive oil to the preheated comal and cook the chicken breasts until browned and cooked through.
Let the chicken breasts rest before chopping them into small pieces.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the comal and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chopped chicken to the comal and stir to combine with the onion and garlic.
Roll out the empanada dough and cut out circles of dough.
Place a spoonful of the chicken mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Fry the empanadas in hot oil until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and serve hot.
